REWRITE of a lost comment (my `rebar comment --body` call stored the literal "--body"; the body arg
is POSITIONAL). Ticket is closed — this restores the record.

INVESTIGATED: does NOT reproduce on origin/main. Closed `duplicate`, resolved by 22f5.

The reporter's stated Approach ("align the project criterion reference with the prompt id loaded by
the runtime") was NOT the cause. The ids match and .rebar/prompts/code-review-project-review-phase-
boundaries.md is committed and correct.

REAL MECHANISM — a repo_root asymmetry between criterion DISCOVERY and prompt RESOLUTION:
  - review-code passed no repo_root (_cli/_llm_commands.py:255-263 -> llm/code_review/shim.py:131,160).
  - Discovery TOLERATES None: llm/criteria/overlay.py:77-88 falls back to config.repo_root(), so the
    criterion is ACTIVATED.
  - Resolution does NOT: llm/prompting/prompts.py:213-221 gates the project-override lookup on
    `if repo_root:`, so a None root skips .rebar/prompts/ and raises PromptNotFound at :226.
  - llm/code_review/batch_runner.py:118-141 wraps that into the reported LLMError.

FIXED BY b3953a0da ("keep project review policy on one code root", rebar-ticket: 22f5-5a48-3ab1-463e,
2026-07-27 20:53), which computes execution_repo_root = cfg.repo_path in llm/workflow/gate_dispatch.py
and passes it to BOTH run_workflow(repo_root=...) and _activated_code_review_project_criteria(...).
This ticket was filed 2026-07-27 17:57 — about three hours BEFORE that fix landed.

RESIDUAL, now tracked separately as dc05-5a87-3f5c-4f99 (CLOSED, merged 10d0542b1): get_prompt's
`if repo_root:` guard was still asymmetric with overlay._resolve_repo_root's cwd fallback, so any
future caller passing None reopened this exact failure. dc05 added a seam agreement check and a
three-case not-found message that names the path actually searched.
